meta.label: Attach EKS cluster
meta.description: Attach to a running EKS cluster

params.name: assumeRoleARN
params.label: IAM Role ARN to assume
params.description: Assumes an IAM role to perform cluster operations instead of the default AWS credential provider chain. If empty, uses AWS credentials defined above

params.name: cacheCredentials
params.label: Enable AWS credential caching
params.description: Cache temporary AWS credentials on disk for aws-iam-authenticator to reduce calls to AWS. Changes apply the next time the kubeconfig is generated.
